home.heroSubtitle: The Future of Autonomous, AI-Driven Secondary Education (Grades 9–12)
home.heroDescription: Experience 24/7 multimodal AI instruction, project-based learning where students spend over 60% of their time building real AI systems, rigorous ethical oversight, and a curriculum engineered for the world ahead.

curriculum.pageSubtitle: A deep dive into every subject across Grades 9–12. Each pillar is engineered to develop a critical dimension of future-ready intelligence.

ai-mastery.name: AI Mastery & Tech Literacy
ai-mastery.description: Advanced AI fluency, coding, and autonomous systems

human-edge.name: Human Edge Skills
human-edge.description: Critical thinking, creativity, and emotional intelligence

ethics-leadership.name: Ethics, Society & Leadership
ethics-leadership.description: Responsible AI stewardship and global citizenship

interdisciplinary.name: Interdisciplinary Domains
interdisciplinary.description: AI applied across science, arts, and real-world domains

g9-prompt.title: Foundations of Prompt Engineering
g9-prompt.description: Master communicating with AI systems through structured prompts, contexts, and few-shot patterns. Students experiment with multimodal prompting (text, image, audio) and learn prompt optimization loops.

g9-logic.title: Logic & Algorithmic Thinking
g9-logic.description: Build computational thinking through formal logic, pseudocode, flowcharts, and basic algorithms. Students progress from Boolean logic to sorting, searching, and graph traversal basics.

g9-python-ai.title: Introduction to Python for AI
g9-python-ai.description: Hands-on Python programming focused on data structures, functions, and libraries essential for AI workloads: NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib.

g9-data-literacy.title: Data Literacy & Visualization
g9-data-literacy.description: Understand how data shapes decisions in society. Students collect, analyze, and present real-world datasets, learning to spot misleading statistics and tell truthful data stories.

g9-critical-thinking.title: Critical Thinking & Argumentation
g9-critical-thinking.description: Develop rigorous habits of mind: identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and constructing sound arguments. Covers logical fallacies, cognitive biases, and structured debate formats.

g9-design-thinking.title: Creative Expression & Design Thinking
g9-design-thinking.description: Apply human-centered design processes to solve real problems. Students prototype using digital tools, physical materials, and iterative feedback cycles.

g9-digital-citizenship.title: Digital Citizenship & Safety
g9-digital-citizenship.description: Explore rights, responsibilities, and risks in digital spaces. Topics include privacy, cybersecurity hygiene, intellectual property, and building healthy digital habits.

g9-ethics-ai.title: Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
g9-ethics-ai.description: Introduction to moral philosophy applied to AI. Students explore trolley problems, algorithmic fairness, and the social consequences of automated decision-making.

g9-global-studies.title: Introduction to Global Studies
g9-global-studies.description: Understand global interdependence, cultural diversity, and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals as a framework for future leadership.

g9-ai-biology.title: AI in Biology & Health
g9-ai-biology.description: Explore how AI revolutionizes biology: protein folding, medical imaging, genomics, and personalized medicine. Students analyze real healthcare datasets.

g9-comp-art.title: Computational Art & Music
g9-comp-art.description: Create generative art, music, and interactive installations using code. Blend creativity with algorithms, exploring randomness, noise fields, and user interaction.

g10-multi-agent.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Systems
g10-multi-agent.description: Design intelligent systems where specialized AI agents collaborate autonomously. Covers agent frameworks, tool use, memory, and coordination protocols.

g10-ml-fundamentals.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
g10-ml-fundamentals.description: Statistical learning theory, linear regression, classification, decision trees, and ensemble methods. Students implement algorithms from scratch and with Scikit-learn.

g10-computer-vision.title: Computer Vision Fundamentals
g10-computer-vision.description: Image processing, convolutional neural networks, object detection, and image segmentation. Real-world projects include facial recognition safety audits and medical imaging.

g10-nlp.title: Natural Language Processing Basics
g10-nlp.description: Text preprocessing, embeddings, transformers, and sentiment analysis. Students build chatbots, text classifiers, and translation prototypes.

g10-creative-comm.title: Advanced Creative Communication
g10-creative-comm.description: Elevate storytelling, persuasive speaking, and multimodal communication. Students create TED-style talks, podcasts, and interactive presentations.

g10-negotiation.title: Negotiation & Mediation Skills
g10-negotiation.description: Principled negotiation, BATNA analysis, mediation techniques, and cross-cultural negotiation. Used in business, diplomacy, and community settings.

g10-eq.title: Emotional Intelligence & Empathy Engineering
g10-eq.description: Self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills. Engineering empathy into AI UX by studying voice tone, facial expression, and body language datasets.

g10-ai-ethics.title: AI Ethics & Global Bias Auditing
g10-ai-ethics.description: Deepened ethics coursework focusing on auditing real AI systems for fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias across cultures, genders, and socioeconomic groups.

g10-philosophy-mind.title: Philosophy of Mind & Consciousness
g10-philosophy-mind.description: What is consciousness? Can machines truly think? Students examine functionalism, integrated information theory, Chinese Room arguments, and ethical implications of sentient AI.

g10-social-impact.title: Social Impact & Community Design
g10-social-impact.description: Design AI solutions for social good using human-centered design and community-based participatory research. Students partner with local organizations.

g10-biomimetic.title: Biomimetic Design
g10-biomimetic.description: Nature-inspired innovation: studying biological systems to solve engineering and design challenges. Includes evolution algorithms, swarm intelligence, and structural optimization.

g10-ai-environment.title: AI in Environmental Science
g10-ai-environment.description: Apply AI to climate modeling, wildlife conservation, precision agriculture, and pollution tracking. Students work with NASA and NOAA open datasets.

g10-math-modeling.title: Mathematical Modeling with AI
g10-math-modeling.description: Use AI and mathematics to model complex systems: epidemiology, urban traffic, economic markets, and ecological networks. Emphasize differential equations and Monte Carlo simulation.

g11-workflow.title: Autonomous Workflow Automation
g11-workflow.description: Design, implement, and monitor fully autonomous AI workflows that integrate APIs, databases, and human-in-the-loop gates for complex operations.

g11-deep-learning.title: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures
g11-deep-learning.description: PyTorch fundamentals, backpropagation, CNN, RNN, Transformer, and GAN architectures. Students implement architectures and train on custom datasets.

g11-rl.title: Reinforcement Learning & Game AI
g11-rl.description: Markov decision processes, Q-learning, policy gradients, and multi-agent RL. Students train agents to play Atari games, board games, and navigate environments.

g11-ai-safety.title: AI Safety & Alignment Research
g11-ai-safety.description: Alignment problem, interpretability, robustness, and scalable oversight. Students conduct small alignment experiments and review current research.

g11-systems-thinking.title: Complex Negotiation & Systems Thinking
g11-systems-thinking.description: Leverage systems thinking frameworks to analyze complex global problems. Includes causal loop diagrams, stock-and-flow models, and multi-stakeholder negotiation.

g11-leadership.title: Leadership in Distributed Teams
g11-leadership.description: Lead remote, cross-functional AI teams. Topics: asynchronous communication, OKRs, psychological safety, conflict resolution, and scaling leadership.

g11-comm.title: Strategic Communication & Public Speaking
g11-comm.description: Craft strategic narratives for technical and non-technical audiences. Students deliver keynotes, investor pitches, white paper briefings, and crisis communications.

g11-corp-governance.title: Corporate Governance in the Age of AI
g11-corp-governance.description: Board-level AI strategy, fiduciary responsibility, algorithmic accountability, and regulatory compliance. Students role-play as C-suite advisors.

g11-ai-policy.title: AI Policy & Regulation Globally
g11-ai-policy.description: Compare AI regulatory frameworks: EU AI Act, US Executive Orders, China AI regulations, and global south perspectives. Students draft model legislation.

g11-tech-ethics.title: Technology Ethics & Moral Philosophy
g11-tech-ethics.description: Advanced normative and applied ethics for technologists: utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and posthumanism.

g11-quant-modeling.title: Quantitative Modeling
g11-quant-modeling.description: Advanced mathematical modeling using AI techniques. Stochastic processes, Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian inference, and optimization algorithms.

g11-ai-economics.title: AI in Economics & Finance
g11-ai-economics.description: Algorithmic trading, market simulation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven economic policy modeling. Students backtest strategies and analyze market data.

g11-comp-neuro.title: Computational Neuroscience
g11-comp-neuro.description: Bridge neuroscience and AI: spiking neural networks, brain-computer interfaces, neural coding, and cognitive modeling.

g12-capstone.title: Capstone Autonomous Application Deployment
g12-capstone.description: Deploy a production-grade autonomous AI application from concept to launch. Covers CI/CD for AI, model serving, monitoring, A/B testing, and incident response.

g12-advanced-ai-arch.title: Advanced AI Systems Architecture
g12-advanced-ai-arch.description: Design large-scale AI infrastructure: model parallelism, memory optimization, quantization, and LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning for LLMs.

g12-ai-science.title: AI for Scientific Discovery
g12-ai-science.description: Use AI to accelerate scientific discovery: protein folding, drug discovery, materials science, and astrophysics. Students contribute to open-science challenges.

g12-llm-eng.title: Large Language Model Engineering
g12-llm-eng.description: Deep dive into LLM internals: KV-cache optimization, speculative decoding, mixture-of-experts, and safety fine-tuning with RLHF and Constitutional AI.

g12-advanced-leadership.title: Advanced Leadership & Public Speaking
g12-advanced-leadership.description: Executive presence, thought leadership, and high-stakes presentation. Students deliver a TED-style keynote and lead a cross-functional initiative.

g12-venture.title: Entrepreneurial Mindset & Venture Design
g12-venture.description: From idea to venture: opportunity recognition, business model design, lean startup, fundraising, and legal structures for AI startups.

g12-cross-cultural.title: Cross-Cultural Communication & Global Leadership
g12-cross-cultural.description: Lead across cultures with emotional intelligence, negotiation, and inclusive communication. Includes study of cultural dimensions and virtual team leadership.

g12-venture-incubation.title: AI-Driven Venture Incubation
g12-venture-incubation.description: Launch an AI-powered startup with ethical business model design. Covers equity, impact measurement, AI product management, and responsible innovation.

g12-futurism.title: Futurism & Scenario Planning
g12-futurism.description: Use foresight methods to anticipate technological, social, and economic futures. Students build scenarios and present strategic recommendations.

g12-tech-policy.title: AI Policy Advocacy & Civic Leadership
g12-tech-policy.description: Transform ethical insight into public action. Students draft policy proposals, engage with lawmakers, and run mock advocacy campaigns.

g12-research-thesis.title: Interdisciplinary Research Thesis
g12-research-thesis.description: Year-long independent research at the intersection of AI and another discipline. Includes literature review, methodology, original analysis, and defense.

g12-ai-space.title: AI in Space Exploration
g12-ai-space.description: Apply AI to space missions: autonomous navigation, satellite image analysis, exoplanet detection, and mission planning with Mars and lunar datasets.

g12-comp-social.title: Computational Social Science
g12-comp-social.description: Use AI and large-scale data to study human behavior: social network analysis, misinformation diffusion, sentiment dynamics, and computational ethics.

compliance.title: Privacy & Compliance
compliance.subtitle: Symbio AI Academy is committed to student data protection and responsible AI use. We operate under strict privacy standards to keep learner data safe, anonymous, and never used for model training.

zeroDataTraining.title: Zero Data-Training API Sandboxing
zeroDataTraining.desc: All student data is processed within isolated sandboxed environments and never used to train external or internal models.

ferpa.title: FERPA School Official Alignment
ferpa.desc: Our platforms align with FERPA guidelines for educational records, ensuring compliance and lawful data stewardship.

deidentified.title: Automated De-Identification
deidentified.desc: We use automated proxy standards to de-identify student data, protecting identities while preserving valuable learning outcomes.
